podcast.body: This song is featured on Neil Diamond's live album "Neil Diamond Gold," recorded at The Troubadour in July 1970. At the time, the crowd reacted with polite applause, long before the song gained its widespread popularity as an anthem at baseball games, bars, and weddings. "Yeah, sweet Carolina's on there, but look, this is decades before we all start singing it at baseball games and in bars and weddings and things like that."
